b3_defects.description: A large blue rectangular ottoman/cushion is floating suspended in mid-air between the desk area and bookshelf (Image 1/2 center).
The object 'printer_01' appears as a detached black volume near the floor lamp legs, lacking grounding on either the table or floor.

worst_object.reason: This large rectangular block appears to be physically disconnected from furniture surfaces and floating in space near the tripod floor lamps.

comment: The scene provides a coherent study room layout but suffers from significant physics glitches where objects are suspended mid-air, breaking immersion. The low-resolution textures contribute to an artificial visual style.
